format.note: double round-robin (22 rounds), then 1st-6th play a championship round and 7th-11th a bottom-five round, each a single round-robin. Top six reach 27 matches, bottom five 26. Whether points carry into the second phase is not stated in the sources.

playoff.note: the top six play a championship round inside the league table; there is no separate final

notes: 11 clubs, double round-robin then a 6/5 split (27 or 26 matches). The top-six championship round is the title route; no relegation marker or count is published for 2026-27. 2025-26 had no promotion or relegation at all because the 2024-25 Cambodian League 2 was cancelled, which is a one-off. Cambodian League 2 (level 2) is not in our rows, so the league is closed both ways in our data even though relegation to League 2 exists in principle. Season label: although Cambodia has been treated as a calendar-year league, the current edition is 2026-27 (5 September 2026 to May 2027); the infobox's '17 May 2026' end date is a typo for 2027. No cups or AFC places included.
